tagline: Connect design work in Figma with task tracking in Todoist
metaTitle: Todoist + Figma Integration: Figma Comments to Todoist Tasks
metaDescription: Turn Figma comments into Todoist tasks, link frames to design tasks and run a handoff checklist. GAIA keeps design to-dos tied to the file. See the setup steps.
intro:
Design work lives in Figma — components, prototypes, and iterations accumulate across files and projects. But the feedback, revisions, and handoff tasks that design work generates need to be tracked somewhere more structured than file comments, which get buried as the file evolves. Designers often end up with a long list of revision requests scattered across comment threads that are difficult to prioritize and even harder to mark as complete.

GAIA connects the two so design feedback becomes actionable tasks and tracked work stays linked to the files it relates to. When a stakeholder leaves a comment on a Figma file, GAIA can capture it as a Todoist task assigned to the designer responsible for that component. When a task is linked to a frame, GAIA surfaces the file link in the task so designers can jump directly to the relevant canvas without hunting through projects.

This integration is valuable for product designers managing feedback from multiple stakeholders across several files, for design teams using Todoist to coordinate shared work, and for design leads who want visibility into revision backlogs without subscribing to comment notifications that overwhelm the inbox.

useCases.title: Convert Figma comments to Todoist tasks
useCases.description: When a stakeholder leaves a revision comment on a file, GAIA creates a task with the comment text, the file and frame link, and the commenter name so nothing slips through.

useCases.title: Link Figma frames to Todoist design tasks
useCases.description: GAIA attaches the relevant frame URL to design tasks so designers can open the exact frame that needs work with one click rather than navigating through the file.

useCases.title: Design handoff checklist
useCases.description: When a file is marked ready for development, GAIA creates a handoff checklist, export assets, update component documentation, notify the engineering team, so handoffs are consistent.

useCases.title: Revision round tracking
useCases.description: GAIA tracks open comments and their linked tasks, alerting the designer when revision tasks are overdue so feedback does not age unaddressed.

useCases.title: Component audit task generation
useCases.description: When a library component is updated, GAIA creates tasks to review screens that use the component, ensuring all affected designs are updated as part of the library change.

howItWorks.step: Connect Todoist and Figma to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authenticate both accounts in GAIA's settings. Select the Figma projects and files you want GAIA to monitor for comments and changes.
Specify which comment types should create tasks, which project receives design tasks, and whether all comments or only those with specific tags trigger task creation.

howItWorks.step: GAIA bridges design feedback and task management
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors for new comments and task-relevant activity, creates tasks automatically, and maintains the link between tasks and frames throughout the revision cycle.

faqs.question: Will GAIA create a task for every Figma comment or only specific ones?
faqs.answer: You can configure GAIA to capture all comments or only those that meet criteria such as containing specific tags, being left by certain people, or being unresolved after a set time.

faqs.question: Can GAIA resolve the comment when the Todoist task is completed?
faqs.answer: Yes. When you mark the linked task complete, GAIA can automatically resolve the corresponding comment so your comment thread stays clean.

faqs.question: Does GAIA work with the branching feature?
faqs.answer: GAIA monitors both main files and branches. Tasks created from branch comments are linked to the branch frame URL and tagged to distinguish them from main file tasks.

faqs.question: Can multiple designers on a team use this integration?
faqs.answer: Yes. Each designer connects their own accounts and GAIA routes comment tasks to the designer assigned to the relevant frame or component.
